event.detail: Reviewed commit: 78e9d68a95119db8452ee139efde13d38546f648. Details: scripts/install.sh:1287 unconditionally prints 'Quit and reopen Farhelm to finish updating. Your sessions keep running.' The source-backed consequence is misleading update guidance; old terminal processes end on reopening, as explicitly required by SPEC.md:3001-3015, Terminal experience. No termination reproduction was run, and this reporting patch does not introduce the underlying termination. Suggested bucket: other for the diagnostic itself; could-be-highest: yes for independent review because it is guidance about an update that ends user processes. SPEC.md:763, Installation and updates, deliberately restores '(sessions keep running, as they do across any quit)'. SPEC_impl.md:7781, The desktop app's updater, deliberately restores '; sessions keep running.' Thus this is a proposed drop requiring the caller's independent check rather than a requested code fix. Checks: read both selected installer/test patches, git show of this commit's SPEC.md and SPEC_impl.md diffs, full Terminal experience migration paragraph at the pinned revision, and the later pinned terminal-substrate implementation contract. possible_cover: none; no queue/ledger/filter/plan searches.
